In a rugged, enclosed mountain basin, a sprawling medieval farm town divides into contrasting halves. The rocky north carries a dense fortified settlement; broad, open farmland spreads south. Massive irregular gray boulders, steep mossy outcrops, scattered grassy plateaus, and narrow turquoise streams ring the scene, water descending through gaps in the rocks in several small white waterfalls.

Inside and around a rectangular walled town, roughly sixty to eighty compact timber-and-stone buildings crowd together. Mostly one- and two-story houses show dark wooden framing, pale infill or masonry walls, and steep orange-brown tiled roofs. Narrow dirt lanes, small courtyards, canals, and bridges wind through their tight organic arrangement. Taller square gate towers and watchtowers punctuate the long timber-and-stone walls.

Beyond the walls, the pattern loosens into fenced fields, orchards, livestock enclosures, winding dirt tracks, isolated cottages, sheds, tents, carts, stacked materials, and scattered rocks. Several tall wooden windmills stand across the fields, some attached to heavy stone or timber tower bases. Additional lookout buildings occupy remote rocky peaks and grassy ledges.

Streams skirt both sides of the settlement, feed small turquoise pools within the town, and pass beneath simple wooden footbridges. Uneven grassy ground carries worn pale paths, low fences, shrubs, tall grass, and thin, irregularly spaced trees. The crowded, layered center yields to open, loosely ordered agricultural outskirts, visibly bounded by cliffs and boulder formations.

clauses.text: In a rugged, enclosed mountain basin, a sprawling medieval farm town divides into contrasting halves
The rocky north carries a dense fortified settlement

Massive irregular gray boulders, steep mossy outcrops, scattered grassy plateaus, and narrow turquoise streams ring the scene, water descending through gaps in the rocks in several small white waterfalls
Inside and around a rectangular walled town, roughly sixty to eighty compact timber-and-stone buildings crowd together
Mostly one- and two-story houses show dark wooden framing, pale infill or masonry walls, and steep orange-brown tiled roofs
Narrow dirt lanes, small courtyards, canals, and bridges wind through their tight organic arrangement
Taller square gate towers and watchtowers punctuate the long timber-and-stone walls
Beyond the walls, the pattern loosens into fenced fields, orchards, livestock enclosures, winding dirt tracks, isolated cottages, sheds, tents, carts, stacked materials, and scattered rocks
Several tall wooden windmills stand across the fields, some attached to heavy stone or timber tower bases
Additional lookout buildings occupy remote rocky peaks and grassy ledges
Streams skirt both sides of the settlement, feed small turquoise pools within the town, and pass beneath simple wooden footbridges
Uneven grassy ground carries worn pale paths, low fences, shrubs, tall grass, and thin, irregularly spaced trees
The crowded, layered center yields to open, loosely ordered agricultural outskirts, visibly bounded by cliffs and boulder formations

deterministic_rule_draft.prompt:
In a rugged, enclosed mountain basin, a sprawling medieval farm town divides into contrasting halves. The rocky north carries a dense fortified settlement; broad, open farmland spreads south. Massive irregular gray boulders, steep mossy outcrops, scattered grassy plateaus, and narrow turquoise streams ring the scene, water descending through gaps in the rocks in several small white waterfalls.

Inside and around a rectangular walled town, roughly sixty to eighty compact timber-and-stone buildings crowd together. Mostly one- and two-story houses show dark wooden framing, pale infill or masonry walls, and steep orange-brown tiled roofs. Narrow dirt lanes, small courtyards, canals, and bridges wind through their tight organic arrangement. Taller square gate towers and watchtowers punctuate the long timber-and-stone walls.

Beyond the walls, the pattern loosens into fenced fields, orchards, livestock enclosures, winding dirt tracks, isolated cottages, sheds, tents, carts, stacked materials, and scattered rocks. Several tall wooden windmills stand across the fields, some attached to heavy stone or timber tower bases. Additional lookout buildings occupy remote rocky peaks and grassy ledges.

Streams skirt both sides of the settlement, feed small turquoise pools within the town, and pass beneath simple wooden footbridges. Uneven grassy ground carries worn pale paths, low fences, shrubs, tall grass, and thin, irregularly spaced trees. The crowded, layered center yields to open, loosely ordered agricultural outskirts, visibly bounded by cliffs and boulder formations.
